name: UFO Summoner
summary: Designed specifically for the 'Encounter of the 3rd Kind' achievement, this UFO Summoner provides instant camera tracking and summoning functionality.
description:
Designed specifically for the 'Encounter of the 3rd Kind' achievement, this UFO Summoner and tracking control panel.

Features:
1. Top-Left Quick Button: Click the 'UFO' button in the top-left corner of the game screen to open the control window.
2. Manual UFO Summon: Trigger the official UFO easter egg on demand without waiting years.
3. Real-time Status Tracker: Live detection of active UFOs, target cows, and current abduction flight phase.
4. Instant Camera Jump: One-click camera tracking for both the UFO and the abducted cow.
5. Great for 'Encounter of the 3rd Kind' Achievement: Easily trigger and observe the UFO event on demand, making it ideal for completing the 'Encounter of the 3rd Kind' achievement.

zh.name: 幽浮召喚器
zh.summary: 專為「第三類接觸」成就設計的 UFO 召喚器，提供即時鏡頭追蹤與召喚功能
zh.description:
專為「第三類接觸」成就設計的 UFO 召喚與追蹤控制面板。

功能特色：
1. 專屬按鈕：點擊遊戲畫面左上角的「UFO」按鈕即可開啟控制視窗。
2. 手動召喚飛碟：隨時一鍵觸發官方外星人抓牛彩蛋，無需等待數年隨機觸發。
3. 即時狀態偵測：即時掌握空域中是否有活躍飛碟、鎖定牛隻與當前吸牛階段。
4. 一鍵鏡頭追蹤：支援一鍵將鏡頭移動並跟隨幽浮或被抓牛隻，近距離觀賞光束牽引過程。
5. 解鎖成就得力助手：隨時依需求召喚飛碟並鎖定觀看，對於完成「第三類接觸」成就非常有幫助。
